title: [otel demo] ad CPU: profiler vs container (${ENV_NAME})
description: Evidence for the Host Profiler's CPU undercount on a CPU-limited pod: the container's own CPU and the profiler's average CPU time, in the same unit, over the same time. Pin the time picker to one :31 to :40 window. Built from git by dd-apply.py.

definition.content: **Pin the time to one window, :31 to :40 UTC.** Left: the container's CPU from the Collector's Kubernetes metrics, converted to ms of CPU per minute (cores x 60,000), the profiler's unit. ad's CPU limit is 300m, which is 18,000 ms per minute. Right: the DDOT Host Profiler's flame graph for ad over the same time; its header gives "Average CPU Time, per minute". On 2026-10-27, 19:31 to 19:40 UTC, the container read 17,993 and the profiler 100. At idle the two roughly agree; the profiler misses the burn.
